description: This file defines a PHP class 'FormatWithMembershipId' that implements a value formatting strategy for membership IDs, retrieving membership names via a service.

classes.name: FormatWithMembershipId
classes.description: A class that formats a membership ID into its corresponding membership name by utilizing the MembershipService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Fetches the membership name corresponding to the given membership ID if available.

methods.name: getMembershipService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of MembershipService.
